Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the common occupation shared by Chris Menges and Aram Avakian was "film editor." While the information gathered by the WebSurfer accurately identified Chris Menges as a cinematographer and film director, and Aram Avakian as a film editor and director, the Planner failed to identify "director" as the shared occupation between the two. Instead, the Planner mistakenly associated "film editor," which only applies to Aram Avakian, as the shared role. This misinterpretation of the information led to the wrong solution being provided.
